title: One group-eval open machine: latest-wins opens, failures that aren't empty
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: the hook is groupEval/useGroupEvalOpen.ts (not useGroupEvalSession.ts), and the prop contract drops from FOURTEEN eval props to one `groupEval` object. Write set SHRANK: GroupEvalModal.tsx is untouched (failures reach it through its existing optional `error` prop, so SimGroupEval is unaffected). Added outside the write set: app/_lib/group-eval-selection-cache.test.ts, a source guard that pinned the probe-key expression inside useDecisionsQueue.ts; it now pins the key in groupEvalOpenMachine.ts and the probe URL in useGroupEvalOpen.ts, and still forbids the old `!rerun && !hasSelection` bypass in all three files. Catalog keys inserted right after decisions.evalCacheProbeFailed (the sibling keys), not at the end of `decisions`. Commit order: catalogs, test, refactor, doc (catalogs and doc each alone under the lock). Extras beyond the 8 cases: the cache-hit governance mismatch now lives in the ready phase (dies with its payload), and Re-run of a FAILED selection run replays its own ids instead of degrading to top-N (rerunSelection). The row busy spinner now also covers the brief probe/start phases.
notes: Whole-tree gates red on foreign paths only, all from siblings' uncommitted work: tsc (PipelineSlaEditor.tsx slaSaveFailed etc., ChainEmptyState.tsx, require-operator.test.ts, stage-sla tests, kpi-sim/ untracked tree), i18n:check (GLYPH_UNKNOWN in api-response.ts has no catalog entry), test:unit 3 BROKEN (loading-gap-debt, error-response-contract, candidateMatrixContracts - none import decisions code), lint:ts-ratchet (@ts-expect-error 2/1 - not in my files), test:perf (12 app/api route overages of a few KB - my files are client-only and imported by no route; only comment mentions in app/api/tasks/route.ts and task-budget.ts). My own: tsc clean on touched files, eslint clean on app/features/hiring/decisions + the selection-cache test, docs:check 0, 336/336 tests in decisions/, groupEval/ and app/_lib/group-eval*. No new eslint-disable (the watch effect uses the latestLoaders ref shape). Slot B note: DecisionsModals now receives `groupEval: GroupEvalOpen` (role, group, view, evaluation, createdAt, error, drift, governanceMismatch, isBusy, open, rerun, close); onRerun is `groupEval.rerun`, so B's `previousEval` capture should wrap it (capture groupEval.evaluation, then call groupEval.rerun()). poolDrift is exported from groupEvalOpenMachine.ts for B's poolChange to sit beside.
